answer_sentences.text: No. A UCB cannot levy foreclosure charges on a floating rate home loan to an individual sanctioned in 2023, because this is an existing floating rate loan to an individual for a non-business purpose and the rule says no pre-payment charges may be charged.
answer_sentences.quote: "For all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges."

answer_sentences.text: This also fits the provision for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025, which says a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.
answer_sentences.quote: "In case of existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers with or without co- obligant(s), a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges."
